_method: Faithful conventional-cubic approximant vs original cell, 2026-07-16. Cells are fcc-primitive stacks (a~7 A, 60 deg; c = 5x or 10x primitive), so C1=A2+p3-A1, C2=A1+p3-A2, C3=A1+A2-p3 (p3=A3/N) gives a ~9.9 A near-cubic frame built from the REAL lattice vectors. Atoms = periodic images of the REAL relaxed structure folded into the box (origin picked by composition score; NO idealized/prototype sites - fixes the June idealized-cubic critique). BVSE values on the cubic grid are a RESAMPLED CROP of the true A-periodic crystal map (distances via A-cell minimum image) -> zero seam artifacts; the box is a display/sampling window, not a period. Channel % = voxels with (BVSE - ORIGINAL-map global min) <= iso. Canonical numbers = original cell; box numbers show representation robustness (+/-1.3 pp for representative boxes). softBV Li-X R0: S 2.105 / Cl 2.249 / O 1.466, b=0.37; BVSE=(BVS-1)^2 valence^2 (empirical, NOT eV); ~0.25 A voxel (grid 28 orig / 40 box). VALIDATION: original-cell fractions reproduce June/July registered values exactly (modelc 1.23/3.32/8.36/17.85; b2o3 6.73/12.22/17.09/21.25).
_lpsocl_first_bvse: NEW: LPSOCl first BVSE - channel volume 4.74% at iso 0.5 (vs modelc 3.32, b2o3 6.73): O-doping also opens Li channels, halfway to the B2O3 champion (+43% vs undoped). perc onsets a/b/c = 0.55/0.35/2.05 val^2.
_b2o3_locality: Dopant-centered box 23.8% vs bulk box 6.2% at iso 0.5 -> channel opening is CONCENTRATED around the B2O3 unit (~4x bulk) but the dopant-free bulk box (S16 Li23 P3 Cl7) still shows 6.2% ~ doped-cell average >> undoped modelc 3.3% -> lattice-wide opening on top of the local effect. Consistent with July b2o3_bvse_channel note (in-plane open, c-axis dopant bottleneck).
